Coordinated Activity Score (CAS): CAS = 0.5 \times \text{coordscore} + 0.3 \times \text{netinflscore} + 0.2 \times \frac{\text{clustsize}}{100}
Technical Evasion Index (TEI): TEI = 0.4 \times \text{vpnratio} + 0.3 \times \frac{\text{proxycount}}{10} + 0.3 \times \frac{\text{ipcountrynum}}{20}
Content Manipulation Score (CMS): CMS = 0.4 \times (1 - \text{cntuniqscore}) + 0.3 \times \text{mediareratio} + 0.3 \times (1 - \text{txtuniq})
Moderation Priority Score (MPS): MPS = 0.3 \times \frac{\text{abuserepnum}}{1000} + 0.4 \times \text{impactval} + 0.3 \times \text{riskval}

technicalinfo.iprepscore: Ranges from 0 to 1. Scores above 0.8 indicate trusted IPs, while scores below 0.3 suggest potentially malicious or compromised IPs.
profile_composition.completeness: Ranges from 0 to 1. Values above 0.8 indicate well-maintained profiles, while values below 0.4 suggest placeholder or abandoned profiles.
moderationaction.trustval: Ranges from 0 to 1. Values above 0.7 indicate highly trusted accounts, while values below 0.3 suggest untrusted or suspicious accounts.
moderationaction.impactval: Ranges from 0 to 1. Values above 0.7 indicate high-impact violations requiring immediate attention, while values below 0.3 suggest low-priority issues.

Cross-Platform Risk Index (CPRI): CPRI = SRS \times (1 + 0.2 \times \text{ipcountrynum})
Network Manipulation Index (NMI): NMI = 0.6 \times BBI + 0.4 \times CAS
Enhanced Trust Score (ETS): ETS = 0.5 \times PCI + 0.5 \times CAS
Coordinated Bot Risk (CBR): CBR = BBI \times CAS \times \frac{\text{clustsize}}{100}
Content Security Index (CSI): CSI = 0.7 \times (1 - CMS) + 0.3 \times CAS
Automated Behavior Score (ABS): ABS = 0.4 \times BBI + 0.3 \times TEI + 0.3 \times (1 - CAS)
Network Trust Score (NTS): NTS = PCI \times (1 - NGV) \times (1 - CBR)
Content Impact Score (CIS): CIS = CMS \times MPS \times \frac{\text{netinflscore}}{100}
Authentication Risk Score (ARS): ARS = 0.5 \times TEI + 0.3 \times (1 - PCI) + 0.2 \times SRS
Behavioral Anomaly Score (BAS): BAS = 0.4 \times BBI + 0.4 \times AAF + 0.2 \times NGV
Temporal Pattern Deviation Score (TPDS): TPDS = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{24} (\frac{\text{obsfreq}_i - \text{expfreq}_i}{\text{expfreq}_i})^2}
Network Influence Centrality (NIC): NIC = 0.4 \times \text{connqualscore} + 0.3 \times \text{netinflscore} + 0.3 \times \text{interactdiv}
Multi-Account Correlation Index (MACI): MACI = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=i+1}^{n} \text{corr}(i,j)}{\binom{n}{2}} where n is linked accounts
Reputation Volatility Index (RVI): RVI = \frac{\sigma_{\text{reputscore}}}{\mu_{\text{reputscore}}} \times (1 + \frac{|\Delta\text{reputscore}|}{\Delta t})
Content Distribution Pattern Score (CDPS): CDPS = 0.4 \times \text{entropy}(\text{posttimes}) + 0.3 \times \text{burstiness} + 0.3 \times (1 - \text{periodicity})
Behavioral Consistency Score (BCS): BCS = (1 - TPDS) \times (1 - RVI) \times (1 - \frac{\text{patterndev}}{100})
Network Synchronization Index (NSI): NSI = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=i+1}^{n} \text{sync}(i,j)}{\text{clustsize}} \times MACI
Content Amplification Effect (CAE): CAE = \text{CIS} \times NIC \times \log(1 + \text{resharecount})
Authentication Pattern Score (APS): APS = (1 - TEI) \times BCS \times (1 - \frac{\text{authanom}}{100})
Cross-Platform Correlation Score (CPCS): CPCS = CPRI \times MACI \times (1 + \frac{\text{platformlinks}}{10})

Network Influence Hub: An account with NIC > 0.8 and CAE > 0.7 that is part of a Coordinated Influence Operation
Advanced Influence Campaign: A Mass Manipulation Campaign containing at least one Network Influence Hub and high NSI
